article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Oct 11, 2022 (BSS) - Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina today asked the authorities concerned to strengthen the market monitoring system to control the inflation especially the uptrend of price of essentials in the country.

The premier gave the directive while chairing a meeting of the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) virtually from her official residence Ganabhaban.

Ministers, state ministers, planning commission members and secretaries concerned attended the meet
